risk_summary: The disclosure is generally quantitative and transparent regarding earnings, loan growth, credit quality, liquidity-related trends, and capital ratios, with an overall cautiously positive tone. Risk is moderated by reliance on sustained low funding costs, loan growth, portfolio concentration in real estate, deposit declines, and unrealized losses on trust preferred securities. Boilerplate forward-looking disclaimers and some apparent textual inconsistencies reduce clarity modestly.
